decisions.reason: For F×F with only e=1, K=(1,1)^T contains [1] but the difference of the two simple classes has zero character. The square unitriangular minor must contain every standard row. Added precisely that hypothesis; triangular elimination then detects every standard coefficient.

The actual cellular supplier proof, step 1.2, establishes x_lambda u_b in N^{>lambda}: for k=1 the full cyclotomic product vanishes; for k>1 the added factor moves one node to the preceding component and finite row straightening yields strictly higher shapes. Its step 2.1 proves two-sided stability. Thus F1 and the initial eigenvalue step use an explicitly proved dependency, not an unsupported external assertion; omission from the supplier Statement does not remove its local derivation.

The supplier actual proof contains the X_1 formula, so that part of the rejection is overstated, but cellularity alone does not imply flagged higher-shape support. Expanded the missing support argument: finite Garnir left words preserve physical component label sets, the exact X_1 correction x_lambda u_b transfers a first-row label to the preceding component, and quadratic subword reductions preserve the prefix flag by Bruhat downward closure. This licenses M_mu inside W_mu and the generic trivial-parabolic upper bound; unlocalized membership, coefficient descent and every-ring specialization are unchanged.

Level one fixes only Lambda=Lambda_j; it does not force j=0. For Lambda_1 the two words are (1,2) and (1,0), so the named alpha_0+alpha_2 sector vanishes. Specified Lambda_0 in the witness and computed X_1=1, X_2=q_H^{-1}T_1^2 on the two scalar factors, giving exactly (0,1) and (0,2). The existential refuted statement and both dimension obstructions are preserved.
